runtime_choices.fabric: lossless switched: host DCB (dscp-prio 26:3, PFC prio 3 on both CX-7 paths per node, Before=docker.service) plus the CRS812 QoS block (roce dscp26->tc3, cnp dscp48->tc6, ECN on queue 3, strict queue 6, trust-l3, pfc-roce, l2mtu 9500); receipts: zero roce_adp_retrans/out_of_sequence increment under the whole 2026-11-22 verification window on all four nodes

tp4-switched.note: 10.5 GiB KV pool per rank (unchanged from 1107; capacity is sizing, not stack)

change_from_previous: spark-ds41f-1107 plus: vLLM 6d66eed3 with the 650-entry A3 series (641 production patches + reworked 0700-0706 retiring B12X end-to-end; 0707/0708 TODO-), TileLang 2123e412 -> ac88f5bc (wheel 0.1.15+snapshot.32a1488d, kernel-cache namespace moves), NCCL 2.30.7-1 + 4 local patches -> stock 2.32.6-1 with an empty series (switched fabric carries no switchless patches), NCCL_BUFFSIZE 1 MiB -> 2 MiB, and the lossless fabric (host DCB PFC + switch QoS) that took roce retrans/out-of-sequence from ~18k/~330k per node-week to zero. Scope: this fork serves the switched site only (owner, 2026-11-22); the switchless shapes keep their 1107-era pins and are not re-qualified here.

evidence.summary: Qualified on tp4-switched (spark-eb1a, 4x DGX Spark): A3 two boots quality 5/5, c1 27.79-28.00/30.30-30.80 ms, prefill 131K 8,654.7; same-session A/B against the 1107 image showed every concurrent point within interval. The 2026-11-22 live verification of the promoted stack: decode judge points at/below the same-session 1107 control (prose-c1 27.93 +-2.6% vs 27.61, code-c1 30.21 +-2.2% vs 30.99), prefill 8,648 +-0.2% at 131K and 7,006 at 524K (reference-cluster centre), quality 5/5, zero retransmit/out-of-sequence increment across the window.
